promptSnapshot: Photorealistic botanical documentary photograph of a single mature female Dr Grinspoon cannabis plant, pure heirloom 100% Sativa. Show the complete plant or enough of the plant to clearly read its architecture. The plant must be tall and thin with slender stems. Its defining mature flowers are unusual compact green and reddish-brown bead-like clusters that hang loosely along thin stems, not conventional thick conical buds. Keep the overall silhouette open and delicate, with realistic sativa foliage and natural internodal spacing. Make the bead-like flower structure unmistakable and botanically plausible. One plant only. No text, labels, infographic, collage, split frame, hands, harvested buds, jars, smoke, or decorative cannabis graphics. Natural photographic lighting and credible horticultural setting. Avoid dense chunky indica-style colas.
